decisions.rationale: Chronos-2 was the strongest foundation-model challenger but produced 18.60 percent worse aggregate MAE, 15.69 percent worse peak-state MAE, no positive outer folds, a 21.05 percent maximum single-fold degradation, and failed the exact deterministic replay control.

TimesFM 2.5 produced 34.36 percent worse aggregate MAE, 16.64 percent worse peak-state MAE, no positive outer folds, a 37.91 percent maximum single-fold degradation, and the highest memory, latency, runtime, and model-size burden among the governed candidates.

Moirai 2.0 produced 29.62 percent worse aggregate MAE, 17.38 percent worse peak-state MAE, no positive outer folds, a 33.19 percent maximum single-fold degradation, and remains independently prohibited from commercial promotion under its CC-BY-NC-4.0 weight license.
